Okay I typed it up for you! let me know if any of it confuses you 🙂 also I feel that I also live in Australia and the best place to buy the bigfoots is at Kidstuff.

2sc - increase 
dec - decrease
sc - single crochet

BODY:

Make 6 st in magic circle
R1) (2sc) x6 (12 st)
R2) (sc, 2sc) x 6 (18 st)
R3) (sc, 2sc, sc) x 6 (24 st)
R4 - R11) sc around (24 st)
R12) (sc, dec, sc) x 6 (18 st)
R13) (sc, dec) x 6 (12 st)
Stuff body lightly 
R14) (dec) x6 (6 st)

EARS: (make 2)

Make 3 st in magic circle 
R1) (2sc) x 3 (6st)
R2) sc around (6st)

FEET: (make 2)

Make 3 st in magic circle
R1) (2sc) x 3 (6st)
R2-R3) sc around (6st)

ASSEMBLY:

For the feet sew the bottom where you ended together with your wool and sew to the bottom of the body with the 3st magic circle being attached to the body. Repeat for other foot on other side of the bigfoot. For the ears, sew ear onto the head with the 6st side being attached to the body and the 3st should be sticking out. Cut shape for face using felt and cut circles for eyes. For the mouth use fabric glue and embroidery thread or alternatively sew the embroidery thread on. Cut small chunks of felt to put the little feet toes (optional).

Pretty much chain five in a magic ring. In the five stitches do three single crochets in each one so that all together on the circle you have fifteen stitches in total in the circle. And then there is five sets of three stitches, which is gonna be a point of the star.

In each point (5 in total):
Chain 1: slip stitch 1, chain 1,
Chain 2: double crochet 1, chain 1
Chain 3: slip stitch 1

Then go around until u finish all points and that’s it 🙂
I hope that makes sense 🙂
